title: purple-mimi step 4: design corrections found while building
description: From the step 4 skeleton (purple-mimi bd75d299, 2026-11-22): (1) mimid's runner logs a failed sync but does not tell its embedder, so a lost stream can't be reported as MIMI_ERR_NETWORK; needs a mimid hook. (2) The runner's tasks can't be aborted from outside; past the grace period the store and its lock are kept until process exit. (3) A stale takeover request would make every later holder release at once; purple-mimi added a freshness rule (older than wait + 5 s is ignored and deleted). (4) The holder's pid isn't recorded, so MIMI_ERR_LOCKED can't name it. Record in docs/design/purple-mimi.md §6/§7.4 and fix (1), (2), (4) in mimid. Remaining step 4 work: cbindgen header, both C glues, CMake, CI, README, LICENSE/SPDX/THIRD-PARTY, headless smoke test (podman images ci/debian13 and ci/purple3 exist in the repo).
